tools.name: tools.search
tools.purpose: Discover authorized capabilities by task; return compact names and descriptions.

tools.name: tools.describe
tools.purpose: Load the exact input/output contracts for one discovered capability.

tools.name: workspace.list
tools.purpose: List one granted directory; do not recurse implicitly.

tools.name: workspace.read
tools.purpose: Read a bounded UTF-8 byte window bound to an optional expected file digest.

tools.name: workspace.search
tools.purpose: Find literal or regex text in an explicitly selected corpus; incomplete scanning remains partial.

tools.name: workspace.create
tools.purpose: Create a new UTF-8 file exclusively; an existing target is a conflict.

tools.name: workspace.mkdir
tools.purpose: Create exactly one directory with an existing parent.

tools.name: workspace.replace
tools.purpose: Replace exact text only at the expected digest and match count.

tools.name: workspace.environment
tools.purpose: Report immutable command handles, dependency gaps and toolchain freshness without loading hooks.

tools.name: workspace.exec
tools.purpose: Run one approved immutable executable with argv in a fresh isolated worker.

tools.name: workspace.verify
tools.purpose: Run one repository-declared check profile against the selected snapshot.

tools.name: workspace.git_status
tools.purpose: Inspect stable Git status, including an unborn branch and untracked paths.

tools.name: workspace.git_diff
tools.purpose: Read bounded canonical changes for explicit paths and index/worktree selection.

tools.name: workspace.git_log
tools.purpose: Inspect bounded commit metadata without executing hooks or text conversion.

tools.name: workspace.git_show
tools.purpose: Read one explicit revision and path from a granted repository.

tools.name: git.branch_create
tools.purpose: Create a feature branch without replacing an existing branch.

tools.name: git.stage
tools.purpose: Stage explicit paths at the expected source snapshot.

tools.name: git.commit
tools.purpose: Commit the reviewed index at its expected digest.

tools.name: git.fetch
tools.purpose: Fetch one registered remote; this changes local Git metadata.

tools.name: git.push
tools.purpose: Push an explicit branch; expected remote identity prevents blind overwrites.

tools.name: git.merge
tools.purpose: Integrate an explicit source ref and report conflicts without discarding edits.

tools.name: code.search
tools.purpose: Find syntax or ranked code candidates; lexical hits are not semantic references.

tools.name: code.outline
tools.purpose: Return a bounded declaration outline for one current source file.

tools.name: code.references
tools.purpose: Return references to an evidenced stable symbol with explicit index freshness.

tools.name: code.graph
tools.purpose: Explore one evidenced symbol's relationships within a finite depth and node budget.

tools.name: code.status
tools.purpose: Report language coverage and index generation without generating an index.

tools.name: docs.resolve
tools.purpose: Resolve a library and exact requested release to a documentation identity.

tools.name: docs.query
tools.purpose: Retrieve bounded primary API evidence for an already resolved documentation identity.

tools.name: research.search
tools.purpose: Discover public primary sources; snippets remain discovery evidence.

tools.name: research.fetch
tools.purpose: Retrieve a selected public HTTPS document with digest-bound continuation.

tools.name: browser.snapshot
tools.purpose: Read rendered page state from one authorized browser session.

tools.name: browser.interact
tools.purpose: Perform one scoped rendered-page action at an expected snapshot.

tools.name: browser.upload
tools.purpose: Upload a granted artifact to one page element at an expected snapshot.

tools.name: artifact.read
tools.purpose: Read an authorized immutable artifact window; a digest alone never grants access.

tools.name: data.query
tools.purpose: Project or aggregate one data artifact in a scratch worker with read-only inputs.

tools.name: compute.execute
tools.purpose: Evaluate bounded scratch-only code with no repository, network or credentials.

tools.name: wasm.transform
tools.purpose: Invoke one allowlisted component and operation bound to immutable digests.

tools.name: build.request
tools.purpose: Request one reviewed build recipe and immutable source/input set; never activate it.

tools.name: build.status
tools.purpose: Observe one owned build without launching duplicate work.

tools.name: build.result
tools.purpose: Observe one owned build without launching duplicate work.

tools.name: build.cancel
tools.purpose: Cancel one owned build and reconcile its terminal outcome.

tools.name: skills.search
tools.purpose: Discover focused reusable guidance by capability without loading bodies.

tools.name: skills.load
tools.purpose: Load one previously discovered guidance document by identity.

tools.name: skills.read_reference
tools.purpose: Read one needed reference from a loaded skill's declared resources.

tools.name: memory.query
tools.purpose: Retrieve scoped reviewed claims with freshness and source evidence.

tools.name: memory.propose
tools.purpose: Propose up to three reusable claims against a current verification receipt.

tools.name: forge.issue_view
tools.purpose: Read one issue through a registered hosting adapter.

tools.name: forge.issue_create
tools.purpose: Create one explicit issue with an idempotency key.

tools.name: forge.pull_request_view
tools.purpose: Read one change request through a registered hosting adapter.

tools.name: forge.pull_request_create
tools.purpose: Create a draft change request for exact base and head refs.

tools.name: forge.pull_request_merge
tools.purpose: Merge only the reviewed expected head using the selected merge method.
